title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: demurrage day rates for dry-class containers
content:
## Scope

This rate card gives the demurrage day rates for a container of the **dry rate class** under each product of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category. Rates are in USD per container per day, one rate for each of the four charge slabs.

## Demurrage day rates, dry class

| Product | Slab 1 day rate | Slab 2 day rate | Slab 3 day rate | Slab 4 day rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 68.00 | 112.00 | 168.00 | 232.00 |

The five products AHL Tariff Free Time, AHL Free Time Extension 3, AHL Free Time Extension 7, AHL Combined Free Time 14 and AHL Combined Free Time 21 share one dry-class demurrage rate ladder; AHL Contract Free Time 30 has its own, lower ladder.

## Reading the card

**Q: What is the dry-class demurrage day rate in slab 2 under AHL Combined Free Time 21?**
A: USD 140.00 per container per day.

**Q: What is the dry-class demurrage rate for a slab 4 day under AHL Contract Free Time 30?**
A: USD 232.00 per container per day, against USD 290.00 under the other five products.

This card states the dry-class demurrage rate of each slab only; the rate class of a given container and the slab of a given day are decided by the rules that govern them.
